_meta.format: F2 structured-input interpretation cards with two fixed, labeled target-language options and concise English metalinguistic feedback
source_evidence: docs/GRAMMAR_STRATEGY.md §§3b and 4 (structured input; form is the only cue to meaning)
docs/research/error-profiles/it.md §§2, 5, and 6 (direct c’era → c’è stato tense-selection error)
docs/research/error-profiles/it.md Addendum (learner explicitly requests passato remoto recognition)
_meta.provenance: Fifty newly authored, bank-attested seed items in standard Italian; no learner sentence or personal data is reproduced. All ten passato remoto forms were cross-checked against the vendored verbecc table.
_meta.register: Neutral news and professional Italian; the passato remoto subset uses historical/reporting-style clauses that are also structurally possible at the imperfetto.
_meta.language_policy: sentence, question, options, answer, and contrast_form are Italian; why is concise English metalinguistic feedback.
_meta.register_semantics: Passato remoto is taught as a bounded perfective narrative tense, common in historical/literary standard prose and still ordinary in some regional speech. It is not defined as objectively distant in time and is not presented as semantically more completed than passato prossimo.
_meta.validation_notes: All 50 source frames are distinct; no contrast_form is repeated as another source sentence. Exactly 20 sources use imperfetto, 20 use passato prossimo, and 10 recognize passato remoto. The c’era/c’è stata family adapts the sole directly attested tense-selection pattern without reproducing its private wording. Apart from required auxiliary, reflexive clitic, and participle agreement, contrast_form changes only target verbal morphology. No time adverb, duration phrase, habitual-frequency expression, completion predicate, or surrounding event independently determines aspect. Content order and correct labels are stored in a frozen, deterministic constrained permutation; labels are cross-balanced by source tense, have no short repeated cycle, and never run more than three times consecutively.
_meta.ordering_policy: Frozen deterministic constraint-solved permutation v2 (seed 3); label and source-category streams reject runs longer than three, six-position period-2 windows, and nine-position period-3 windows in the full sequence and relevant routed subsequences.
